title: 12 Best Romantic Restaurants in Rome
description: Discover Rome's most romantic restaurants for an unforgettable date night. From rooftop views to intimate trattorias, find your perfect spot in the Eternal City.

places.name: Aroma Restaurant (Palazzo Manfredi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Tasting Menu' is highly recommended to experience the chef's full creativity, paired with their extensive wine list.

places.name: La Pergola (Rome Cavalieri)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Grand Tasting Menu' is a journey through gastronomic artistry. Don't miss their water menu, a unique offering.

places.name: Imàgo (Hotel Hassler)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Signature Tasting Menu' is a fantastic way to experience Chef Antonini's vision. Their tiramisu is also a refined classic.

places.name: Antico Arco
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous Carbonara is a must-try – widely regarded as one of Rome's best. Also, explore their seasonal secondi.

places.name: Per Me Giulio Terrinoni
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Percorso di Mare' (Seafood Journey) tasting menu is highly recommended to experience Terrinoni's artistry. Their pasta dishes with seafood are also exceptional.

places.name: Pianostrada Laboratorio di Cucina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their house-made bread and focaccia are legendary. Don't miss their fresh pasta dishes or their creative fish and vegetable mains.

places.name: Hostaria Da Pietro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Saltimbocca alla Romana and Cacio e Pepe are exemplary. They also have excellent fresh fish daily.

places.name: Roscioli Salumeria con Cucina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Cacio e Pepe, made with incredible Pecorino, is a revelation. Also, order a platter of their world-class cured meats and cheeses.

places.name: Da Enzo al 29
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Rigatoni all'Amatriciana and Coda alla Vaccinara (oxtail stew) are legendary. Save room for their Tiramisu.

places.name: Taverna Trilussa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Bucatini all'Amatriciana' or 'Tonnarelli Cacio e Pepe' served in the pan are signature dishes and a must-try. Also, explore their carciofi (artichoke) preparations.

places.name: Settimo Roman Cuisine & Terrace
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their tasting menu is a great value for the quality and view. The carbonara is also a beautifully executed classic.

places.name: Armando al Pantheon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their rigatoni alla carbonara, bucatini all'amatriciana, and saltimbocca are legendary. Check for seasonal specials like carciofi alla romana.
